summary: 32 RV sites confirmed from the county tourism listing only; the city's own site (ocindiana.com) has no campground page and no operator rate exists. Fees stay absent. Note cleaned of the site count.
flags: NO RATE: no operator page. City Hall site ocindiana.com does not mention the campground. Reviews only: Google, 2 months ago: 'Primitive sites right on the lake... Only 15 bucks a night'; 2023: 'extremely cheap with nice sites. Only water and electric is available. There is a dump station'. Not written. Rate needs a call: 812-568-1390 (Google; 'Call Chris' on a search snippet).

WATER: lakefront stands. On imagery the loop's pads are about 20-50 m from the lake on open grass with a dock; a second row of pads north of the camp road is 150+ m back. Overpass did not answer; imagery estimates.
PIN: good. On the camp road about 90 m from the loop.

GOOGLE: 4.6 from 121 reviews. So-so lines read: 'They do not have a bathhouse but they do have a few primitive style bathrooms'; 'some showers would be nice'; 'Can no longer hike or explore the south side of the lake... sold to an individual' (edited 4 years ago).
